CustomField.description: Which of the three form types this is: Form (bound to one Salesforce object), Survey (answer store with survey analytics), or Freeform (its own submission store, with optional mappings to any number of objects)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Form: you know which Salesforce data you need. Survey: you want feedback and analysis. Freeform: you know what you want to ask and will decide later where the answers go.
CustomField.label: Form Type
